overview: ValuBrix is an institutional-grade AI-powered property intelligence platform for Bangalore real estate. It delivers premium map visualization with glassmorphic level selectors and 10 infrastructure layer toggles across Buy, Rent, Sell, AI Valuation, and Area Intelligence portals — backed by 10,000+ verified training data points.
features: 10 infrastructure layer toggles (Metro, Railway, Bus, Hospital, School, College, Tech Park, Mall, Airport, Highway)
Multi-layer pin support with animated markers and distance labels
Bottom-left floating legend card for active layers
Pin clustering on zoom out, expand on zoom in
10,000+ verified training data points across North-West, East, and South Bangalore
Unified AI engines for valuation, rental, and area intelligence
